## Objective
- Desarrollar Reinos por partes, MVP por MVP, usando su hoja de ruta y validando cada función antes de continuar.

## Requirements
- Trabajar únicamente sobre checkpoint 18 de Reinos; no mezclar los checkpoints 19, 21, 22 o 23 ni ramas remotas de otros proyectos sin confirmar que correspondan a Reinos.
- Usar `main` como rama única de desarrollo y evitar complicar el proyecto con ramas.
- No declarar funciones implementadas o verificadas si no lo están.
- Priorizar HUD reconocible de Argentum Online, inventario y pociones visibles, combate legible, efectos de hechizos y apuntado visible e independiente, sin autoaim ni autoclick invisible.
- Implementar decisiones tácticas de Inmo, Remo y escape, distintos intervalos de ataques y hechizos, y el enfrentamiento solicitado 4v4.
- Mantener actualizada “DESARROLLO ABIERTO · MVP POR MVP / Hoja de ruta de Reinos” con pedidos, tecnologías, recursos, clases y pendientes.
- Avanzar por partes y desarrollar las funciones indicadas en la hoja de ruta.

## Decisions
- Fuente elegida: `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revisión `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- No incorporar `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` ni `origin/opencode-deployments/4`: pertenecen al issue #4 y no se confirmó que correspondan a Reinos.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recuperados los archivos de aplicación y recursos del checkpoint 18; incorporada la hoja de ruta a `index.html` y actualizado el origen en `README.md`.
- Corregidos roster de ocho combatientes, IDs de puntuación, reinicio, selector de objetivo y afirmaciones de roadmap sobre 4v4 y verificación.
- Pasaron `node --check game.js` y la validación JSON de `assets/ao/map.json`, `assets/ao/characters.json` y `assets/ao/grhs.json`.
- Chromium validó roster, reinicio, clase/hechizos, pociones, colocación de NPC y apuntado de hechizo; también se comprobó daño a distancia y melee con feedback visible.
- Capturas de validación guardadas en `/tmp/opencode/reinos-combat.png` y `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.png`.

### Active
- Iniciar el ciclo iterativo solicitado tomando la hoja de ruta como backlog, definiendo criterios de aceptación para cada MVP y desarrollando una parte por vez.

### Blocked
- No hay rama local `main` ni referencia remota disponible de `main`; los cambios de Reinos siguen sin commit.
- No se ha establecido ni publicado `main`; conservar el estado actual sin incorporar ramas del issue #4 por accidente.

## Next Move
1. Definir el primer MVP de la hoja de ruta y su criterio de aceptación.
2. Resolver el flujo de ramas creando o estableciendo `main` con el estado de Reinos, sin mezclar ramas de otros proyectos.
3. Implementar el MVP seleccionado, validarlo y actualizar la hoja de ruta con resultados y pendientes.
4. Revisar `git status` y dejar explícito qué sigue local, comprometido o publicado.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: interfaz y hoja de ruta.
- `game.js`: combate, actores, HUD, IA, apuntado y controles.
- `styles.css`: presentación y HUD.
- `README.md`: procedencia del checkpoint e instrucciones de ejecución.
- `assets/ao/`: recursos de mapa, gráficos y datos AO.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: prueba interactiva Chromium/CDP.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: prueba de ataque cuerpo a cuerpo.

## Important Context
- El prototipo tiene ocho actores, pero sigue siendo todos contra todos; las reglas y composición 4v4 todavía no están implementadas.
- Estado Git más reciente: rama `opencode/42336396183`, `HEAD` en `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”); solo `README.md` modificado y `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh` y `styles.css` sin seguimiento.

## Objective
- Desarrollar Reinos por MVPs pequeños, usando la hoja de ruta como backlog y validando cada etapa antes de continuar.

## Requirements
- Trabajar únicamente sobre checkpoint 18 de Reinos; no mezclar checkpoints 19, 21, 22 o 23 ni ramas remotas de otros proyectos sin confirmar que correspondan.
- Usar `main` como rama de desarrollo y no complicar el proyecto con ramas.
- No declarar funciones implementadas o verificadas si no lo están.
- Priorizar HUD reconocible de Argentum Online, inventario y pociones visibles, combate legible, efectos de hechizos y apuntado visible e independiente, sin autoaim ni autoclick invisible.
- Implementar decisiones tácticas de Inmo, Remo y escape, intervalos distintos para ataques y hechizos, y enfrentamiento 4v4.
- Mantener actualizada la hoja de ruta de Reinos con pedidos, tecnologías, recursos, clases y pendientes.
- Avanzar de a una parte por vez.

## Decisions
- Fuente elegida: `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revisión `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- No incorporar `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` ni `origin/opencode-deployments/4`: corresponden al issue #4 y no se confirmó que sean de Reinos.
- Se creó la rama local `main` desde el estado de trabajo actual; no se incorporaron las ramas remotas del issue #4.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recuperados los archivos de aplicación y recursos del checkpoint 18; incorporada la hoja de ruta en `index.html` y actualizado el origen en `README.md`.
- Corregidos roster de ocho combatientes, IDs de puntuación, reinicio, selector de objetivo y afirmaciones de roadmap sobre 4v4 y verificación.
- Pasaron `node --check game.js` y la validación JSON de `assets/ao/map.json`, `assets/ao/characters.json` y `assets/ao/grhs.json`.
- Chromium validó roster, reinicio, clase/hechizos, pociones, colocación de NPC y apuntado de hechizo; también se comprobó daño a distancia y melee con feedback visible.
- Capturas de validación previas disponibles en `/tmp/opencode/reinos-combat.png` y `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.png`.
- Creada la rama local `main` con `git switch -c main`.

### Active
- Seleccionar el primer MVP de la hoja de ruta, fijar criterios de aceptación y desarrollarlo/validarlo por partes.
- El prototipo sigue siendo local, de todos contra todos, con ocho combatientes; el 4v4 por equipos continúa pendiente.

### Blocked
- `main` no tiene rama remota disponible para publicar; los cambios permanecen sin commit.
- El objeto de checkpoint señalado (`bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`) no está presente en este checkout (`git cat-file` respondió `could not get object info`).

2: 
3: Prototipo web jugable inspirado en Argentum Online. Incluye una arena de combate local, movimiento por tiles, bots, ataques cuerpo a cuerpo, habilidades por clase y controles táctiles; funciona en navegador sin backend.

6: 
7: Serví esta carpeta por HTTP, por ejemplo:
8: 
9: ```bash
10: python3 -m http.server 8000
11: ```
12: 
13: Después abrí <http://localhost:8000>.
14:

16: 
17: - **Flechas o WASD:** moverse.
18: - **Clic en un personaje o Tab:** elegir objetivo.
19: - **F o Enter:** atacar al objetivo adyacente.
20: - **1–3:** elegir/cancelar habilidad; luego clic en un rival para atacar o en tu personaje para curarte.
21: - **Combatientes / Esc:** mostrar el marcador o cerrar paneles.
22: - **☰:** pausar o reanudar.
23: - **Móvil:** pad táctil para moverse y botón de ataque.

28: - `assets/ao/`: mapa, datos de personajes y gráficos usados por el juego.

## Audit findings

The current prototype is still local, tile-stepped, and free-for-all. The roadmap explicitly marks 4v4 and combat changes as pending (`/home/runner/work/Argentum_Online_AGITE/Argentum_Online_AGITE/index.html:74, 80–83`), so those are not treated here as completed features.

### Highest-impact defects

1. **Team assignments don’t consistently constrain combat or victory.** Teams and roles are assigned in `game.js:11–19`, but `attack` (`238–251`) and `castSkill` (`334–370`) don’t consistently prevent friendly fire. `selectTarget` (`435–438`) accepts any living NPC. The bots choose enemies (`193–198`), but victory is still an individual five-kill condition (`415–429, 797–802`); team constants and scores (`58–60`) do not make this a team-based match.

2. **Cleric healing is mismatched and does not work as intended.** Cleric skills are declared with `type: 'healAlly'` (`40–41`), while self-target checks, player casting, and bot healing look for `heal` (`316, 344–370, 533–538`). NPC healing would only heal the caster, not an ally. This affects both player skill use and NPC tactics.

3. **NPC healing and spell behavior are coupled to the basic attack cooldown.** `attackCd` and `skillCooldowns` are separate systems (`73–76, 579–585`), but bot healing checks and resets `attackCd` (`533–538`), and NPC ranged spells also require it (`545`). That can block unrelated actions and interfere with basic attacks.

4. **NPC melee uses the spell-style aiming flow.** Basic melee attacks enter the visible aim phase (`260–271, 561–563`), although the guide describes melee as an adjacent-target action (`index.html:113`). This makes NPC melee behavior and feedback inconsistent with the documented action.

### Other roadmap gaps

- Movement is discrete tile-stepped (`game.js:49, 178–192, 514–519`), not continuous as requested by roadmap item 03.
- NPC aim graphics use a fixed rotating palette and place `APUNTANDO` at the cursor (`game.js:673–695`); the user cursor remains generic (`737–751`).
- Character rendering includes health bars but no per-combatant mana bars (`game.js:636–654`).

These are gaps against the requested roadmap, not evidence that the pending roadmap scope is already implemented.

## Safely scoped implementation order

1. **Define and enforce combat rules:** make teams, legal targets, friendly-fire behavior, and win conditions consistent across player attacks, skills, NPC choices, and match resolution.
2. **Fix healing semantics:** use one explicit healing target/type convention, then apply it consistently to player casting and NPC ally selection. Ensure NPC healing does not consume or reset the basic-attack cooldown.
3. **Separate NPC action timing and feedback:** keep melee distinct from ranged spell aiming; verify that skill cooldowns and attack cooldowns only govern their respective actions.
4. **Add combat feedback and HUD work:** spell-colored aiming/cursor feedback and mana bars can follow once action types and targets are reliable.
5. **Treat continuous movement and the remaining 4v4/tactical roadmap work as separate scope:** they are larger behavior changes and should not be bundled into the fixes above.

## Verification criteria

- Players and NPCs cannot attack or damage invalid targets; team victory is determined by the agreed team rule.
- Clerics can target and heal valid allies, while invalid targets are rejected consistently for both player and NPC casting.
- Healing or casting does not unexpectedly block, reset, or consume the basic-attack cooldown.
- NPC melee does not enter the spell-aim phase; ranged attacks still provide the intended aim feedback.
- HUD and movement changes are checked against their specific roadmap requirements, without claiming 4v4 or continuous movement is complete until tested.

## Objective
- Desarrollar Reinos en MVPs pequeños, usando la hoja de ruta como backlog y validando cada etapa antes de continuar.

## Requirements
- Trabajar únicamente sobre checkpoint 18; no mezclar checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23 ni ramas del issue #4 sin confirmar que correspondan.
- Avanzar de a una parte por vez y no declarar funciones implementadas o verificadas si no lo están.
- Priorizar HUD reconocible de Argentum Online, inventario y pociones visibles, combate legible, efectos de hechizos y apuntado visible e independiente, sin autoaim ni autoclick invisible.
- Implementar decisiones tácticas de Inmo, Remo y escape, intervalos distintos para ataques y hechizos, y enfrentamiento 4v4.
- Mantener actualizada la hoja de ruta de Reinos con pedidos, tecnologías, recursos, clases y pendientes.

## Decisions
- Fuente elegida: `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revisión `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- No incorporar `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` ni `origin/opencode-deployments/4`: corresponden al issue #4 y no se confirmó que sean de Reinos.
- Se creó la rama local `main` para el trabajo.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recuperados los archivos de aplicación y recursos del checkpoint 18; incorporada la hoja de ruta en `index.html` y actualizado el origen en `README.md`.
- Corregidos roster de ocho combatientes, IDs de puntuación, reinicio, selector de objetivo y afirmaciones de roadmap sobre 4v4 y verificación.
- Pasaron `node --check game.js` y la validación JSON de `assets/ao/map.json`, `assets/ao/characters.json` y `assets/ao/grhs.json`.
- Chromium validó roster, reinicio, clase/hechizos, pociones, colocación de NPC y apuntado; también se comprobó daño a distancia y melee con feedback visible.
- Se creó `main` desde el estado de trabajo actual.

### Active
- Elegir el primer MVP de la hoja de ruta, fijar criterios de aceptación y desarrollarlo/validarlo por partes.

### Blocked
- No hay rama `main` remota disponible; los cambios permanecen sin commit.
- El objeto de checkpoint `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` no está presente en este checkout (`git cat-file` respondió `could not get object info`).

## Next Move
1. Elegir el primer MVP y definir criterios de aceptación verificables desde la hoja de ruta.
2. Continuar sobre la rama local `main`, sin incorporar referencias del issue #4.
3. Implementar y validar ese MVP; actualizar la hoja de ruta con resultados y pendientes.

- `index.html`: interfaz y hoja de ruta de Reinos.
- `game.js`: combate, actores, HUD, IA, apuntado y controles.
- `styles.css`: presentación y HUD.
- `README.md`: procedencia e instrucciones de ejecución.

- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: prueba interactiva Chromium/CDP.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: prueba de ataque cuerpo a cuerpo.

- El estado Git observado antes del cambio de rama era `opencode/42336396183`, con `README.md` modificado y `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh` y `styles.css` sin seguimiento; luego se creó `main` desde ese estado.

## Objective
- Desarrollar Reinos en MVPs pequeños, usando la hoja de ruta como backlog y validando cada etapa antes de continuar.
- El usuario pidió implementar todo y pushear a `main`; ese alcance amplio todavía requiere organizarse en partes verificables.

## Requirements
- Trabajar únicamente sobre checkpoint 18; no mezclar checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23 ni ramas del issue #4 sin confirmar que correspondan.
- Avanzar de a una parte por vez y no declarar funciones implementadas o verificadas si no lo están.
- Priorizar HUD reconocible de Argentum Online, inventario y pociones visibles, combate legible, efectos de hechizos y apuntado visible e independiente, sin autoaim ni autoclick invisible.
- Implementar decisiones tácticas de Inmo, Remo y escape, intervalos distintos para ataques y hechizos, y enfrentamiento 4v4.
- Mantener actualizada la hoja de ruta de Reinos con pedidos, tecnologías, recursos, clases y pendientes.
- La petición más reciente del usuario es: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Decisions
- Fuente elegida: `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revisión `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- No incorporar `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` ni `origin/opencode-deployments/4`: corresponden al issue #4 y no se confirmó que sean de Reinos.
- Se creó la rama local `main` para el trabajo.
- La auditoría recomendó comenzar por equipos y objetivos como base para el 4v4, sin mezclar aún IA, balance ni reconstrucción completa del HUD.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recuperados los archivos de aplicación y recursos del checkpoint 18; incorporada la hoja de ruta en `index.html` y actualizado el origen en `README.md`.
- Corregidos roster de ocho combatientes, IDs de puntuación, reinicio, selector de objetivo y afirmaciones de roadmap sobre 4v4 y verificación.
- Pasaron `node --check game.js` y la validación JSON de `assets/ao/map.json`, `assets/ao/characters.json` y `assets/ao/grhs.json`.
- Chromium validó roster, reinicio, clase/hechizos, pociones, colocación de NPC y apuntado; también se comprobó daño a distancia y melee con feedback visible.
- Se creó `main` desde el estado de trabajo actual.
- Auditoría de combate completada: detectó combate/victoria todavía no basados plenamente en equipos y desajustes de curación de clérigos.

### Active
- Implementar la hoja de ruta completa en incrementos probables y verificables; comenzar con equipos/objetivos y luego continuar con tácticas, enfriamientos, HUD, efectos y demás pendientes.
- No se han hecho cambios nuevos tras la auditoría; falta convertir los hallazgos en implementaciones y pruebas.

### Blocked
- No hay rama `main` remota disponible; los cambios permanecen sin commit y no se pueden pushear hasta resolver/configurar el remoto.
- El objeto de checkpoint `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` no está presente en este checkout (`git cat-file` respondió `could not get object info`).

## Next Move
1. Revisar la auditoría y el estado actual de Git antes de editar; preservar los archivos sin seguimiento existentes.
2. Implementar equipos y objetivos: prevenir fuego amigo, restringir selección a rivales y convertir puntuación/victoria a resultado por equipo.
3. Corregir curación de clérigos (`healAlly` frente a `heal`) y probar selección de aliado, curación propia y de NPC.
4. Abordar los siguientes MVPs en partes pequeñas, actualizando la hoja de ruta solo con resultados realmente comprobados.
5. Validar cada parte con sintaxis y pruebas de navegador; revisar cambios y estado Git.
6. Confirmar remoto disponible y permisos antes de publicar; hacer commit y push a `main` solo si el destino correcto está confirmado.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: interfaz, estado del modo y hoja de ruta.
- `game.js`: roster, selección, combate, curación, IA, puntuación y reinicio.
- `styles.css`: presentación y HUD.
- `README.md`: procedencia e instrucciones de ejecución.
- `assets/ao/`: recursos de mapa, gráficos y datos AO.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: prueba interactiva Chromium/CDP.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: prueba de ataque cuerpo a cuerpo.

## Important Context
- El estado Git es rama `main`, con `README.md` modificado y `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh` y `styles.css` sin seguimiento; aún no hay commit.
- El repositorio solo lista `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` y `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; no hay `main` remota.
- La auditoría encontró: `selectTarget` acepta aliados; ataque/hechizos no bloquean consistentemente fuego amigo; victoria sigue usando condición individual de cinco bajas; `healAlly` no coincide con comprobaciones que buscan `heal`.
- El prototipo sigue siendo local, de todos contra todos, con ocho combatientes; el 4v4 por equipos continúa pendiente.
- En la prueba melee el objetivo bajó de 88% a 73%; no hubo mensaje nuevo en el registro, aunque el daño visual fue apreciable.

## Objective
- Implement Reinos in small, verifiable MVPs using the roadmap, then commit and push the work to `main`.

## Requirements
- Work only from checkpoint 18; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Proceed incrementally, distinguishing implemented and verified features from pending work.
- Prioritize recognizable Argentum Online HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, visible independent aiming, and no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the Reinos roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.
- User asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; those relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- Work is on local `main`; `origin` points to `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`.
- The current `origin` advertises a `main` branch, superseding the earlier claim that no remote main exists.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered checkpoint application/resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance in `README.md`.
- Existing work corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, and roadmap claims about 4v4 and verification.
- Prior validation passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Audited combat and identified team/friendly-fire/win-condition and cleric healing mismatches.
- Latest inspection reconfirmed source locations for combat, targeting, scores, HUD, and roadmap; no new edits were made.

### Active
- Implement team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire, restrict hostile targets to enemies, and make scoring/victory team-based.
- Correct cleric healing (`healAlly` is used in profiles while implementation/AI checks `heal`); support valid ally and self-healing as intended.
- Continue roadmap MVPs in small independently tested increments: tactics, cooldowns, HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests.

- The desired checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` previously returned `could not get object info`).
- Current working files are uncommitted; many recovered project files are untracked. Local `main` currently points to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”), so inspect carefully before staging or pushing.

03 · MOVIMIENTO E IA · FLUIDEZ Y DECISIONES

Combatientes ágiles que rotan, persiguen y escapan

  • El movimiento actual por casilleros y la conducta de los bots se sienten lentos, torpes y con lag; no cumplen el ritmo solicitado.
  • Rehacer el movimiento para que sea continuo y fluido, con aceleración/cambios de dirección legibles y respuesta inmediata, sin pausas largas entre casilleros ni desplazamiento a tirones.
  • Los agentes deben correr y reposicionarse por distintos sectores de la arena, no quedarse plantados frente al jugador o rival esperando para pegar.
  • Eliminar la estrategia de alinearse, chocar de frente y apretar pegar hasta matar. El combate no debe resolverse como una fila estática de golpes cuerpo a cuerpo.
  • Crear decisiones de combate observables y variadas: perseguir, escapar, esquivar, cambiar de posición, rodear, buscar línea/ángulo, intentar inmovilizar, remover Inmo y volver a atacar o huir.
  • Si dos combatientes están a melee, aprovechar el intervalo entre golpes: pegar, retirarse mientras recarga el ataque y volver a entrar cuando corresponda; los hechizos también tienen su propio intervalo. No permanecer quietos intercambiando golpes, salvo la excepción táctica del guerrero sin maná que busca el golpe básico.
  • El ritmo de combate debe dejar dominar la secuencia golpe básico → hechizo → golpe básico → hechizo, sin resolver golpes y hechizos demasiado rápido. Ajustar y probar por separado los intervalos de ataque y lanzamiento contra referencias verificables de Argentum Online; no inventar ni presentar valores provisionales como tiempos oficiales.
  • Iniciar el combo con intentos deliberados de Inmo y, al inmovilizar al rival, aprovechar la ventana para ejecutar Inmo-Golpe; priorizar Remo en cuanto el rol pueda y escapar/reposicionarse rápidamente, sin quedarse quieto golpeando. Hacer observables los intentos de Inmo, Remo y la huida.
  • El combate debe ser peligroso y veloz: bajo Inmo, quedarse quieto puede costar la vida en alrededor de un segundo. Ajustar daño de golpes y hechizos, vida, maná y tiempos de respuesta para que ese ritmo sea posible sin volver el resultado arbitrario; probar y documentar los valores, que siguen pendientes de referencia y balance.
  • La IA debe decidir según distancias, objetivos, estado de Inmo/Remo, riesgo y situación del equipo; el movimiento rápido no debe ser aleatorio ni hacer trampa con información invisible.
  • Acercarse a melee solo cuando haya una razón táctica; priorizar movimiento, hechizos, persecución y evasión para producir el agite frenético pedido.
  • El enfrentamiento objetivo es 4v4 por equipos: Legión Sagrada (azul) contra Legión Caótica (roja), con un guerrero sin maná que busca golpes básicos, un mago que solo lanza hechizos, un clérigo que remueve y sana/cura heridas al guerrero, y un paladín que intenta Inmo-Golpe en cada lado. Los roles deben usar Inmo y Remo de forma funcional según corresponda; esta composición sigue pendiente de implementar.
  • Validar en juego que se mueven con fluidez y rapidez, que cambian de plan y que no vuelven al patrón de quedarse cara a cara atacándose repetidamente.

## Objective
- Implement Reinos in small, verifiable MVPs using the roadmap, then commit and push the work to `main`.
- The user requested: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work only from checkpoint 18; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Proceed incrementally, distinguishing implemented and verified features from pending work.
- Prioritize recognizable Argentum Online HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, visible independent aiming, and no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the Reinos roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` points to `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; remote `main` exists and must be compared before publishing.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered checkpoint application/resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance in `README.md`.
- Existing work corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, and roadmap claims about 4v4 and verification.
- Prior validation passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Audited combat and identified team/friendly-fire/win-condition and cleric healing mismatches.

### Active
- Implement team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire, restrict hostile targets to enemies, and make scoring/victory team-based.
- Correct cleric healing (`healAlly` is used in profiles while implementation/AI checks `heal`); support valid ally and self-healing as intended.
- Continue roadmap MVPs in small independently tested increments: tactics, cooldowns, HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests.

### Blocked
- The desired checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` previously returned `could not get object info`).
- Current working files are uncommitted; many recovered project files are untracked. Local `main` points to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).
- Remote `main` has not been fetched/compared with the local work; reconcile history and confirm the intended push base before committing or pushing.

## Next Move
1. Inspect Git status, ignore rules, and diffs; preserve existing untracked/user work.
2. Fetch and inspect `origin/main`; establish how the recovered checkpoint work relates to it before committing.
3. Implement team-aware target validation, friendly-fire prevention, and team victory/scoring.
4. Fix cleric healing type checks and verify ally/self/NPC healing behavior.
5. Run syntax, data, and browser regression tests; update roadmap only for verified results.
6. Review staged changes, commit to the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the remote destination and ancestry.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, and project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.

- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked.

## Objective
- Implement Reinos incrementally from the intended checkpoint, verify each MVP, update the roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the Reinos roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; fetched `origin/main` matches local `main` at `5291e3e`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance in `README.md`.
- Existing work corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, and roadmap claims about 4v4 and verification.
- Prior validation passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Audited combat and identified friendly-fire, team scoring/victory, and cleric healing mismatches.
- Latest edits in `game.js` block friendly melee attacks, recognize `healAlly`, permit ally healing targets, and heal the chosen ally with matching effect/feedback. These edits are not yet tested.

### Active
- Finish team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire in spells and NPC attacks, restrict hostile targets to enemies, and make scoring/victory team-based.
- Complete cleric healing behavior, including AI healing of allies and self-healing as intended; verify ally/self/NPC cases.
- Continue roadmap MVPs incrementally: tactics, cooldowns, HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests.
- Reconcile recovered project files with repository history, then validate, commit, and push only when the intended `main` base is confirmed.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` previously returned `could not get object info`).
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Local and remote `main` point to the grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”); the checkpoint’s ancestry cannot currently be established.

## Next Move
1. Inspect current status and diffs, preserving recovered and untracked project files.
2. Finish team-aware target validation, friendly-fire prevention, and team scoring/victory.
3. Fix and test cleric ally/self healing and relevant AI behavior.
4. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only for verified results.
5. Review and commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, then push after confirming the intended base.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status before the recent edits: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked. The recent `game.js` edits are also uncommitted.
- Current combat is not yet fully team-based: `nearestEnemy()` uses team membership, but attacks/spells and win conditions still need consistent team validation and resolution; `kill()` currently ends the match at five player kills.
- Cleric profiles declare `type: 'healAlly'`; recent edits updated player targeting/healing, but AI still searches for `type === 'heal'`.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs` and `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs` are earlier browser test scripts; Chromium is available at `/usr/bin/chromium`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Implement Reinos incrementally from checkpoint 18, verify each MVP, maintain the roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user requested: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the Reinos roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; fetched `origin/main` matches local `main` at `5291e3e`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance in `README.md`.
- Existing work corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, and roadmap claims about 4v4 and verification.
- Prior validation passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Latest edits block friendly melee attacks, recognize `healAlly`, permit ally healing targets, and heal the chosen ally with matching effect/feedback. These latest edits remain untested.

### Active
- Finish team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire in NPC spell resolution, restrict hostile targets consistently, and implement team-based scoring/victory.
- Finish cleric healing behavior, including AI healing allies and intended self-healing; verify ally/self/NPC cases.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, validate, then commit and push only after confirming the intended `main` base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- The project files are uncommitted; many are untracked. Local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”), so publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Inspect status and diffs, preserving recovered and untracked work.
2. Finish team-aware target validation, friendly-fire prevention, and team-based scoring/victory.
3. Fix and test cleric ally/self healing and relevant AI behavior.
4. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update the roadmap only for verified results.
5. Confirm the intended history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: earlier browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: earlier browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked.
- Current combat is not fully team-based: `nearestEnemy()` uses team membership, but NPC spell targets, scoring, and win conditions still need consistent team validation; `kill()` ends the match at five player kills.
- Cleric profiles declare skills as `type: 'healAlly'`, while bot AI still searches for `type === 'heal'`.
- The latest `castSkill()` changes allow ally healing, but `isSelfTarget()` still treats only `heal` and `remove` as self-targeted, and player self-healing interactions/UI require review.

## Objective
- Implement Reinos incrementally from checkpoint 18, verify each MVP, maintain the roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user requested: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the Reinos roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; fetched `origin/main` matches local `main` at `5291e3e`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance in `README.md`.
- Existing work corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, and roadmap claims about 4v4 and verification.
- Prior validation passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.

## Objective
- Implement Reinos incrementally from checkpoint 18, verify each MVP, maintain the roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user requested: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the Reinos roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; fetched `origin/main` matches local `main` at `5291e3e`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Earlier checks passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.

### Active
- Finish team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire in NPC spell resolution, restrict hostile targets consistently, and implement team-based scoring/victory.
- Finish cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered/untracked work.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- The project files are uncommitted; many are untracked. Local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”), so publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Add team-aware target restrictions, prevent NPC friendly fire, and implement team-based scoring and match victory.
2. Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and test all target cases.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: earlier browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: earlier browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked.
- `game.js` has 4v4 team assignments and `teamScores`, `TEAM_LABELS`, `TEAM_COLORS`, `isAlly()`, and `isEnemy()`, but `kill()` still ends the match at five player kills, and the HUD/roster still says “todos contra todos.”
- `resolveNpcAim()` applies offensive skills without checking that the target is an enemy; enforce team restrictions there and in selection/target UI.
- Cleric skills are `healAlly`; player casting can target an ally, but `isSelfTarget()` recognizes only `heal` and `remove`, and canvas handling rejects clicking the player for cleric healing. Bot AI searches for `type === 'heal'`, so clerics do not heal allies.
- Existing browser test scripts are available at `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs` and `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`.

Cómo avanzar sin perder pedidos

  • Usar esta hoja como lista visible de alcance, estado y próximos pasos; actualizarla al cerrar cada MVP.
  • Trabajar en entregas pequeñas, independientes y revisables; explicar supuestos en vez de presentar ideas nuevas como pedidos confirmados.
  • Separar con claridad lo implementado, lo verificado visualmente, lo pendiente y lo que es solo una propuesta futura.
  • Antes de añadir contenido, revisar el pedido y el estado actual para evitar duplicar trabajo o dar por terminado algo que solo está dibujado.
  • En cada etapa comprobar que no se rompa lo que ya funcionaba en escritorio, móvil, teclado y controles táctiles.

Fundación web y arena de prueba

  • Canvas 2D, interfaz HTML y estilos CSS sin framework; JavaScript ejecutado en el navegador.
  • Prototipo servido por HTTP y recursos locales en assets/ao/; no depende de backend ni motor externo.
  • Un mapa renderizado en Canvas y ocho combatientes (el jugador y siete bots móviles) en modalidad todos contra todos; los equipos de 4v4 siguen pendientes.
  • Movimiento cardinal por casilleros mediante flechas o WASD; selección de rival, apuntado, melee y ataques de NPC telegrafiados.
  • Marcador, objetivo de cinco bajas, registro de batalla, panel de combatientes y ayuda de controles presentes en la interfaz.

## Objective
- Complete Reinos incrementally from checkpoint 18, verify the MVPs, update the roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user requested: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the Reinos roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; fetched `origin/main` matches local `main` at `5291e3e`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Earlier checks passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.

### Active
- Finish team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire in NPC spell resolution, restrict hostile targets consistently, and implement team-based scoring/victory.
- Finish cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered/untracked work.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- The project files are uncommitted; many are untracked. Local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”), so publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Add team-aware target restrictions, prevent NPC friendly fire, and implement team-based scoring and match victory.
2. Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and test all target cases.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: earlier browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: earlier browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked.
- `game.js` has 4v4 team assignments and `teamScores`, `TEAM_LABELS`, `TEAM_COLORS`, `isAlly()`, and `isEnemy()`, but `kill()` still ends the match at five player kills, and the HUD/roster still says “todos contra todos.”
- `resolveNpcAim()` applies offensive skills without checking that the target is an enemy; enforce team restrictions there and in selection/target UI.
- Cleric skills are `healAlly`; player casting can target an ally, but `isSelfTarget()` recognizes only `heal` and `remove`, and canvas handling rejects clicking the player for cleric healing. Bot AI searches for `type === 'heal'`, so clerics do not heal allies.
- Existing browser test scripts are available at `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs` and `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`.

## Objective
- Complete Reinos incrementally from checkpoint 18, verify the MVPs, update the roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user requested: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the Reinos roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; fetched `origin/main` matches local `main` at `5291e3e`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Earlier checks passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.

### Active
- Finish team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire in NPC spell resolution, restrict hostile targets consistently, and implement team-based scoring/victory.
- Finish cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered/untracked work.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- The project files are uncommitted; many are untracked. Local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”), so publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Add team-aware target restrictions, prevent NPC friendly fire, and implement team-based scoring and match victory.
2. Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and test all target cases.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: earlier browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: earlier browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked.
- `game.js` has 4v4 team assignments and `teamScores`, `TEAM_LABELS`, `TEAM_COLORS`, `isAlly()`, and `isEnemy()`, but `kill()` still ends the match at five player kills, and the HUD/roster still says “todos contra todos.”
- `resolveNpcAim()` applies offensive skills without checking that the target is an enemy; enforce team restrictions there and in selection/target UI.
- Cleric skills are `healAlly`; player casting can target an ally, but `isSelfTarget()` recognizes only `heal` and `remove`, and canvas handling rejects clicking the player for cleric healing. Bot AI searches for `type === 'heal'`, so clerics do not heal allies.
- Existing browser test scripts are available at `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs` and `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`.

## Objective
- Complete Reinos incrementally from checkpoint 18, verify the MVPs, update the roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user requested: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the Reinos roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; fetched `origin/main` matches local `main` at `5291e3e`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Earlier checks passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.

### Active
- Finish team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire in NPC spell resolution, restrict hostile targets consistently, and implement team-based scoring/victory.
- Finish cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- The project files are uncommitted; many are untracked. Local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”), so publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Add team-aware target restrictions, prevent NPC friendly fire, and implement team-based scoring and match victory.
2. Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and test all target cases.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: earlier browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: earlier browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked.
- `game.js` has 4v4 team assignments and `teamScores`, `TEAM_LABELS`, `TEAM_COLORS`, `isAlly()`, and `isEnemy()`, but `kill()` still ends the match at five player kills, and the HUD/roster still says “todos contra todos.”
- `resolveNpcAim()` applies offensive skills without checking that the target is an enemy; enforce team restrictions there and in selection/target UI.
- Cleric skills are `healAlly`; player casting can target an ally, but `isSelfTarget()` recognizes only `heal` and `remove`, and canvas handling rejects clicking the player for cleric healing. Bot AI searches for `type === 'heal'`, so clerics do not heal allies.

    Combatientes ágiles que rotan, persiguen y escapan

    • El movimiento actual por casilleros y la conducta de los bots se sienten lentos, torpes y con lag; no cumplen el ritmo solicitado.

    • Los agentes deben correr y reposicionarse por distintos sectores de la arena, no quedarse plantados frente al jugador o rival esperando para pegar.

3: Prototipo web jugable inspirado en Argentum Online. Incluye una arena de combate local, movimiento por tiles, bots, ataques cuerpo a cuerpo, habilidades por clase y controles táctiles; funciona en navegador sin backend.
4: 
5: ## Ejecutar
6: 
7: Serví esta carpeta por HTTP, por ejemplo:
8:

11: ```

16: 
17: - **Flechas o WASD:** moverse.
18: - **Clic en un personaje o Tab:** elegir objetivo.

23: - **Móvil:** pad táctil para moverse y botón de ataque.

## Objective
- Complete Reinos from checkpoint 18, verify the MVPs, update the roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user requested: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the Reinos roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; fetched `origin/main` matches local `main` at `5291e3e`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Earlier checks passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.

### Active
- Finish team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire in NPC spell resolution, restrict hostile targets consistently, and implement team-based scoring/victory.
- Finish cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- The project files are uncommitted; many are untracked. Local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”), so publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Add team-aware target restrictions, prevent NPC friendly fire, and implement team-based scoring and match victory.
2. Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and test all target cases.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: earlier browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: earlier browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked.
- `game.js` has 4v4 team assignments and `teamScores`, `TEAM_LABELS`, `TEAM_COLORS`, `isAlly()`, and `isEnemy()`, but `kill()` still ends the match at five player kills, and the HUD/roster still says “todos contra todos.”
- `resolveNpcAim()` applies offensive skills without checking that the target is an enemy; enforce team restrictions there and in selection/target UI.
- Cleric skills are `healAlly`; player casting can target an ally, but `isSelfTarget()` recognizes only `heal` and `remove`, and canvas handling rejects clicking the player for cleric healing. Bot AI searches for `type === 'heal'`, so clerics do not heal allies.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Clearly distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Earlier checks passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Latest inspection confirmed the roadmap explicitly says 4v4 and combat improvements are pending/unverified, while the match strip still incorrectly says “8 COMBATIENTES · TODOS CONTRA TODOS.”

### Active
- Finish team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire in NPC spell resolution, restrict hostile targets consistently, and implement team-based scoring/victory.
- Finish cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- The project files are uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Add team-aware target restrictions, prevent NPC friendly fire, and implement team-based scoring and match victory.
2. Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and test all target cases.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked.

- `resolveNpcAim()` applies offensive skills without checking that the target is an enemy; enforce team restrictions there and in selection/target UI.
- Cleric skills are `healAlly`; player casting can target an ally, but `isSelfTarget()` recognizes only `heal` and `remove`, and canvas handling rejects clicking the player for cleric healing. Bot AI searches for `type === 'heal'`, so clerics do not heal allies.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Earlier checks passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.

### Active
- Finish team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire in NPC spell resolution, restrict hostile targets consistently, and implement team-based scoring/victory.
- Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Add team-aware target restrictions, prevent NPC friendly fire, and implement team-based scoring and match victory.
2. Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and test all target cases.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked.
- `game.js` has 4v4 team assignments and `teamScores`, `TEAM_LABELS`, `TEAM_COLORS`, `isAlly()`, and `isEnemy()`, but `kill()` still ends the match at five player kills, and the HUD/roster still says “todos contra todos.”
- `resolveNpcAim()` applies offensive skills without checking that the target is an enemy; enforce team restrictions there and in selection/target UI.
- Cleric skills are `healAlly`; player casting can target an ally, but `isSelfTarget()` recognizes only `heal` and `remove`, and canvas handling rejects clicking the player for cleric healing. Bot AI searches for `type === 'heal'`, so clerics do not heal allies.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Earlier checks passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Reviewed relevant combat, HUD, match-end, reset, and README code; no new edits were made in the latest turn.

### Active
- Finish team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire in NPC spell resolution, restrict hostile targets consistently, and implement team-based scoring/victory.
- Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Add team-aware target restrictions, prevent NPC friendly fire, and implement team-based scoring and match victory.
2. Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and test all target cases.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked.
- `game.js` has 4v4 team assignments and `teamScores`, `TEAM_LABELS`, `TEAM_COLORS`, `isAlly()`, and `isEnemy()`, but `kill()` still ends the match at five player kills, and the HUD/roster still says “todos contra todos.”
- `resolveNpcAim()` applies offensive skills without checking that the target is an enemy; enforce team restrictions there and in selection/target UI.
- Cleric skills are `healAlly`; player casting can target an ally, but `isSelfTarget()` recognizes only `heal` and `remove`, and canvas handling rejects clicking the player for cleric healing. Bot AI searches for `type === 'heal'`, so clerics do not heal allies.
