## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Earlier checks passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Latest turn reviewed relevant sections of `game.js`, `index.html`, and `README.md`; no edits or tests were performed.

### Active
- Finish team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire in NPC spell resolution, restrict hostile targets consistently, and implement team-based scoring/victory.
- Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Add team-aware target restrictions, prevent NPC friendly fire, and implement team-based scoring and match victory.
2. Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and test all target cases.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked.
- `game.js` has 4v4 team assignments and `teamScores`, `TEAM_LABELS`, `TEAM_COLORS`, `isAlly()`, and `isEnemy()`, but `kill()` still ends the match at five player kills, and the HUD/roster still says “todos contra todos.”
- `resolveNpcAim()` applies offensive skills without checking that the target is an enemy; enforce team restrictions there and in selection/target UI.
- Cleric skills are `healAlly`; player casting can target an ally, but `isSelfTarget()` recognizes only `heal` and `remove`, and canvas handling rejects clicking the player for cleric healing. Bot AI searches for `type === 'heal'`, so clerics do not heal allies.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Earlier checks passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Most recent code review confirmed `isEnemy`, `nearestEnemy`, and ally target checks exist, but no edits or tests were made in that turn.

### Active
- Finish team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire in NPC spell resolution, restrict hostile targets consistently, and implement team-based scoring/victory.
- Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Add team-aware target restrictions, prevent NPC friendly fire, and implement team-based scoring and match victory.
2. Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and test all target cases.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked.
- `game.js` has 4v4 team assignments and `teamScores`, `TEAM_LABELS`, `TEAM_COLORS`, `isAlly()`, and `isEnemy()`, but `kill()` still ends the match at five player kills, and the HUD/roster still says “todos contra todos.”
- `resolveNpcAim()` applies offensive skills without checking that the target is an enemy; enforce team restrictions there and in selection/target UI.
- Cleric skills are `healAlly`; player casting can target an ally, but `isSelfTarget()` recognizes only `heal` and `remove`, and canvas handling rejects clicking the player for cleric healing. Bot AI searches for `type === 'heal'`, so clerics do not heal allies.

Cómo avanzar sin perder pedidos

  • Usar esta hoja como lista visible de alcance, estado y próximos pasos; actualizarla al cerrar cada MVP.
  • Trabajar en entregas pequeñas, independientes y revisables; explicar supuestos en vez de presentar ideas nuevas como pedidos confirmados.

01 · BASE JUGABLE · IMPLEMENTADO

Fundación web y arena de prueba

  • Canvas 2D, interfaz HTML y estilos CSS sin framework; JavaScript ejecutado en el navegador.
  • Prototipo servido por HTTP y recursos locales en assets/ao/; no depende de backend ni motor externo.
  • Un mapa renderizado en Canvas y ocho combatientes (el jugador y siete bots móviles) en modalidad todos contra todos; los equipos de 4v4 siguen pendientes.
  • Movimiento cardinal por casilleros mediante flechas o WASD; selección de rival, apuntado, melee y ataques de NPC telegrafiados.
  • Marcador, objetivo de cinco bajas, registro de batalla, panel de combatientes y ayuda de controles presentes en la interfaz.

Qué está integrado y qué falta traer

  • Tecnologías en uso: HTML5 para estructura/HUD; CSS responsive sin framework; JavaScript vanilla; Canvas 2D para mundo, sprites y efectos; JSON para mapa/definiciones/personajes; PNG para láminas; Python 3 para extracción opcional; servidor HTTP estático para desarrollo. ## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Earlier checks passed `node --check game.js`, JSON parsing of map/character/Grh data, and browser checks for roster, reset, class/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.

### Active
- Finish team-aware combat: prevent friendly fire in NPC spell resolution, restrict hostile targets consistently, and implement team-based scoring/victory.
- Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Add team-aware target restrictions, prevent NPC friendly fire, and implement team-based scoring and match victory.
2. Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and test all target cases.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked.
- `game.js` has 4v4 team assignments and `teamScores`, `TEAM_LABELS`, `TEAM_COLORS`, `isAlly()`, and `isEnemy()`, but `kill()` still ends the match at five player kills, and the HUD/roster still says “todos contra todos.”
- `resolveNpcAim()` applies offensive skills without checking that the target is an enemy; enforce team restrictions there and in selection/target UI.
- Cleric skills are `healAlly`; player casting can target an ally, but `isSelfTarget()` recognizes only `heal` and `remove`, and canvas handling rejects clicking the player for cleric healing. Bot AI searches for `type === 'heal'`, so clerics do not heal allies.

3: Prototipo web jugable inspirado en Argentum Online. Incluye una arena de combate local, movimiento por tiles, bots, ataques cuerpo a cuerpo, habilidades por clase y controles táctiles; funciona en navegador sin backend.

6: 
7: Serví esta carpeta por HTTP, por ejemplo:
8: 
9: ```bash

11: ```
12:

16:

18: - **Clic en un personaje o Tab:** elegir objetivo.

22: - **☰:** pausar o reanudar.
23: - **Móvil:** pad táctil para moverse y botón de ataque.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.

- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Updated `game.js` to reject friendly NPC aim targets, centralize player skill-target validation, allow `healAlly` targeting of self or teammates, and track team kill scores with a five-kill goal and team-aware match results. These latest edits have not been tested.

### Active
- Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases; bot AI still searches for `type === 'heal'`, but cleric skills use `healAlly`.
- Review team target selection and presentation for consistency; update `index.html` from “todos contra todos” and individual five-kill objective to 4v4 teams and team goal.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

1. Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and validate team-aware targeting and scoring.
2. Update the HUD/roster/objective copy to reflect 4v4 team scoring.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, team scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.

- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Updated `game.js` to reject friendly NPC aim targets, centralize player skill-target validation, allow `healAlly` targeting of self or teammates, and track team kill scores with a five-kill goal and team-aware match results.

### Active
- Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases; `updateBots()` still searches for `skill.type === 'heal'`, but cleric skills use `healAlly`.
- Review team target selection and presentation for consistency; update `index.html` from “todos contra todos” and individual five-kill objective to 4v4 teams and team goal.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Fix cleric AI healing and validate team-aware targeting and scoring.
2. Update the HUD/roster/objective copy to reflect 4v4 team scoring.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, team scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

- `teamScores` increments on kills; a team reaching five ends the match, and timeout results use team scores. The player’s HUD progress reflects their team score; review the still-outdated `index.html` copy and per-player kill display.
- `resolveNpcAim()` checks `isEnemy(actor, target)` before resolving NPC attacks.
- Player skill validation uses `canTargetWithSkill(actor, target, skill)`; `healAlly` permits teammates, including self. `handleCanvasTarget()` and `selectTarget()` reject invalid friend/enemy targets.
- `endMatch(_won, winnerTeam = null)` determines the winner from team scores, with a tie outcome. Latest edits have not been tested.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Updated `game.js` to reject friendly NPC aim targets, centralize player skill-target validation, allow `healAlly` targeting of self or teammates, and track team kill scores with a five-kill goal and team-aware match results.

### Active
- Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases; `updateBots()` still searches for `skill.type === 'heal'`, but cleric skills use `healAlly`.
- Review team target selection and presentation for consistency; update `index.html` from “todos contra todos” and individual five-kill objective to 4v4 teams and team goal.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Fix cleric AI healing and validate team-aware targeting and scoring.
2. Update the HUD/roster/objective copy to reflect 4v4 team scoring.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, team scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked. No commit or push has occurred.
- `teamScores` increments on kills; a team reaching five ends the match, and timeout results use team scores. The player’s HUD progress reflects their team score; review the still-outdated `index.html` copy and per-player kill display.
- `resolveNpcAim()` checks `isEnemy(actor, target)` before resolving NPC attacks.
- Player skill validation uses `canTargetWithSkill(actor, target, skill)`; `healAlly` permits teammates, including self. `handleCanvasTarget()` and `selectTarget()` reject invalid friend/enemy targets.
- `endMatch(_won, winnerTeam = null)` determines the winner from team scores, with a tie outcome. Latest edits have not been tested.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Updated `game.js` to reject friendly NPC aim targets, centralize player skill-target validation, allow `healAlly` targeting of self or teammates, and track team kill scores with a five-kill goal and team-aware match results.

### Active

- Review team target selection and presentation for consistency; update `index.html` from “todos contra todos” and individual five-kill objective to 4v4 teams and team goal.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.
- Reconcile recovered files with repository history, commit changes on the appropriate `main` history, and push only after confirming the intended base.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Fix cleric AI healing and validate team-aware targeting and scoring.
2. Update the HUD/roster/objective copy to reflect 4v4 team scoring.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, team scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.

- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked. No commit or push has occurred.

- `endMatch(_won, winnerTeam = null)` determines the winner from team scores, with a tie outcome. Latest edits have not been tested.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Updated `game.js` to reject friendly NPC aim targets, centralize player skill-target validation, allow `healAlly` targeting of self or teammates, and track team kill scores with a five-kill goal and team-aware match results.

### Active
- Fix cleric AI/self/ally healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases; `updateBots()` still searches for `skill.type === 'heal'`, but cleric skills use `healAlly`.
- Review team target selection and presentation for consistency; update `index.html` from “todos contra todos” and individual five-kill objective to 4v4 teams and team goal.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Fix cleric AI healing and validate team-aware targeting and scoring.
2. Update the HUD/roster/objective copy to reflect 4v4 team scoring.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, team scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked. No commit or push has occurred.

- Player skill validation uses `canTargetWithSkill(actor, target, skill)`; `healAlly` permits teammates, including self. `handleCanvasTarget()` and `selectTarget()` reject invalid friend/enemy targets.
- `endMatch(_won, winnerTeam = null)` determines the winner from team scores, with a tie outcome. Latest edits have not been tested.

3: Prototipo web jugable inspirado en Argentum Online. Incluye una arena de combate local, movimiento por tiles, bots, ataques cuerpo a cuerpo, habilidades por clase y controles táctiles; funciona en navegador sin backend.

11: ```

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Updated `game.js` to reject friendly NPC aim targets, centralize player skill-target validation, allow `healAlly` targeting of self or teammates, and track team kill scores with a five-kill goal and team-aware match results.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Updated `game.js` to reject friendly NPC aim targets, centralize player skill-target validation, allow `healAlly` targeting of self or teammates, and track team kill scores with a five-kill goal and team-aware match results.

### Active
- Fix cleric AI healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases; `updateBots()` still searches for `skill.type === 'heal'`, but cleric skills use `healAlly`.
- Review team target selection and presentation for consistency; update `index.html` from “todos contra todos” and individual five-kill objective to 4v4 teams and team goal.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Fix cleric AI healing and validate team-aware targeting and scoring.
2. Update the HUD/roster/objective copy to reflect 4v4 team scoring.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, team scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked. No commit or push has occurred.
- `teamScores` increments on kills; a team reaching five ends the match, and timeout results use team scores. The player’s HUD progress reflects their team score; review the still-outdated `index.html` copy and per-player kill display.
- `resolveNpcAim()` checks `isEnemy(actor, target)` before resolving NPC attacks.
- Player skill validation uses `canTargetWithSkill(actor, target, skill)`; `healAlly` permits teammates, including self. `handleCanvasTarget()` and `selectTarget()` reject invalid friend/enemy targets.
- `endMatch(_won, winnerTeam = null)` determines the winner from team scores, with a tie outcome. Latest edits have not been tested.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.

### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Updated `game.js` to reject friendly NPC aim targets, centralize player skill-target validation, allow `healAlly` targeting of self or teammates, and track team kill scores with a five-kill goal and team-aware match results.

### Active
- Fix cleric AI healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases; `updateBots()` still searches for `skill.type === 'heal'`, but cleric skills use `healAlly`.
- Review team target selection and presentation for consistency; update `index.html` from “todos contra todos” and individual five-kill objective to 4v4 teams and team goal.

- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Updated `game.js` to reject friendly NPC aim targets, centralize player skill-target validation, allow `healAlly` targeting of self or teammates, and track team kill scores with a five-kill goal and team-aware match results.

### Active
- Fix cleric AI healing and verify ally/self/NPC cases; `updateBots()` still searches for `skill.type === 'heal'`, but cleric skills use `healAlly`.
- Review team target selection and presentation for consistency; update `index.html` from “todos contra todos” and individual five-kill objective to 4v4 teams and team goal.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Fix cleric AI healing and validate team-aware targeting and scoring.
2. Update the HUD/roster/objective copy to reflect 4v4 team scoring.
3. Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; update roadmap only to reflect verified behavior.
4. Inspect all changes and preserve recovered files.
5. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, team scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked. No commit or push has occurred.
- `teamScores` increments on kills; a team reaching five ends the match, and timeout results use team scores. The player’s HUD progress reflects their team score; review the still-outdated `index.html` copy and per-player kill display.
- `resolveNpcAim()` checks `isEnemy(actor, target)` before resolving NPC attacks.
- Player skill validation uses `canTargetWithSkill(actor, target, skill)`; `healAlly` permits teammates, including self. `handleCanvasTarget()` and `selectTarget()` reject invalid friend/enemy targets.
- `endMatch(_won, winnerTeam = null)` determines the winner from team scores, with a tie outcome. Latest edits have not been tested.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Updated `game.js` to reject friendly NPC aim targets, centralize player skill-target validation, allow `healAlly` targeting of self or teammates, and track team kill scores with a five-kill goal and team-aware match results.
- Fixed bot healing to recognize both `heal` and `healAlly`; bots select the most injured living ally (including themselves), apply healing and cooldowns, and emit a healing visual effect.
- `node --check game.js` and JSON parsing of `assets/ao/map.json` passed; local HTTP server responded successfully.

### Active
- Review team target selection and presentation for consistency; update `index.html` from “todos contra todos” and individual five-kill objective to 4v4 teams and team goal.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.
- Resolve intended project history, then commit and push to `main`.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Update HUD, roster, and roadmap text to accurately describe 4v4 teams, team scoring, and verified features.
2. Run browser regression checks, including cleric healing, ally/enemy targeting, scoring, reset, and rendering; inspect any remaining combat requirements.
3. Review all changes and ensure recovered files are preserved.
4. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, team scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked. No commit or push has occurred.
- `teamScores` increments on kills; a team reaching five ends the match, and timeout results use team scores. The player’s HUD progress reflects their team score; review the still-outdated `index.html` copy and per-player kill display.
- `resolveNpcAim()` rejects non-enemy targets; player skill targeting uses `canTargetWithSkill(actor, target, skill)`, with `healAlly` allowed on teammates including self. `handleCanvasTarget()` and `selectTarget()` reject invalid friend/enemy targets.
- `endMatch(_won, winnerTeam = null)` determines the winner from team scores, with a tie outcome. Latest edits, including bot healing, have not been browser-tested.

  • Usar esta hoja como lista visible de alcance, estado y próximos pasos; actualizarla al cerrar cada MVP.

01 · BASE JUGABLE · IMPLEMENTADO

Fundación web y arena de prueba

  • Canvas 2D, interfaz HTML y estilos CSS sin framework; JavaScript ejecutado en el navegador.
  • Prototipo servido por HTTP y recursos locales en assets/ao/; no depende de backend ni motor externo.
  • Un mapa renderizado en Canvas y ocho combatientes (el jugador y siete bots móviles) en modalidad todos contra todos; los equipos de 4v4 siguen pendientes.
  • Movimiento cardinal por casilleros mediante flechas o WASD; selección de rival, apuntado, melee y ataques de NPC telegrafiados.
  • Marcador, objetivo de cinco bajas, registro de batalla, panel de combatientes y ayuda de controles presentes en la interfaz.

  • Tecnologías en uso: HTML5 para estructura/HUD; CSS responsive sin framework; JavaScript vanilla; Canvas 2D para mundo, sprites y efectos; JSON para mapa/definiciones/personajes; PNG para láminas; Python 3 para extracción opcional; servidor HTTP estático para desarrollo. Google Fonts se solicita en línea. No hay motor de juego, dependencias de npm, backend, base de datos ni red multijugador.
  • Render y sonido: el cliente dibuja el mapa y personajes con Canvas; algunos iconos son caracteres Unicode/CSS. Los tonos son generados con Web Audio; no se importaron música ni efectos de sonido como archivos.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Updated `game.js` to reject friendly NPC aim targets, centralize player skill-target validation, allow `healAlly` targeting of self or teammates, and track team kill scores with a five-kill goal and team-aware match results.
- Fixed bot healing to recognize both `heal` and `healAlly`; bots select the most injured living ally (including themselves), apply healing and cooldowns, and emit a healing visual effect.
- `node --check game.js` and JSON parsing of `assets/ao/map.json` passed; local HTTP server responded successfully.

### Active
- Review team target selection and presentation for consistency; update `index.html` from “todos contra todos” and individual five-kill objective to 4v4 teams and team goal.
- Continue roadmap MVPs: tactics, cooldowns, AO-style HUD, visual effects, aiming, and remaining requests; update claims only after verification.
- Run syntax, data, and browser regression checks; inspect changes and preserve recovered files.
- Resolve intended project history, then commit and push to `main`.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Update HUD, roster, and roadmap text to accurately describe 4v4 teams, team scoring, and verified features.
2. Run browser regression checks, including cleric healing, ally/enemy targeting, scoring, reset, and rendering; inspect any remaining combat requirements.
3. Review all changes and ensure recovered files are preserved.
4. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, team scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked. No commit or push has occurred.
- `teamScores` increments on kills; a team reaching five ends the match, and timeout results use team scores. The player’s HUD progress reflects their team score; review the still-outdated `index.html` copy and per-player kill display.
- `resolveNpcAim()` rejects non-enemy targets; player skill targeting uses `canTargetWithSkill(actor, target, skill)`, with `healAlly` allowed on teammates including self. `handleCanvasTarget()` and `selectTarget()` reject invalid friend/enemy targets.
- `endMatch(_won, winnerTeam = null)` determines the winner from team scores, with a tie outcome. Latest edits, including bot healing, have not been browser-tested.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).
- Current `game.js` implements 4v4 teams with Sacred/Chaotic team scores, a five-kill team goal, team-aware match results, ally healing, and friendly-fire restrictions; update the UI and roadmap claims to match actual behavior instead of reverting logic.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Updated `game.js` to reject friendly NPC aim targets, centralize player skill-target validation, allow `healAlly` targeting of self or teammates, and track team kill scores with a five-kill goal and team-aware match results.
- Fixed bot healing to recognize both `heal` and `healAlly`; bots select the most injured living ally, apply healing and cooldowns, and emit a healing visual effect.
- `node --check game.js` passed; earlier JSON parsing of `assets/ao/map.json` and local HTTP server response checks passed.
- Inspected the latest `index.html` and confirmed stale UI/roadmap copy still claims “todos contra todos” and individual “5 bajas,” despite team scoring in code.
- Latest `node --check game.js` passed.

### Active
- Update `index.html` headings, objective, roster/panel text, and roadmap to accurately describe the implemented 4v4 teams and five-kill team score; reconcile claims about what is implemented versus still pending.
- Run browser regression checks for cleric healing, ally/enemy targeting, team scoring, reset, and rendering; inspect remaining combat requirements.
- Review all changes and preserve recovered files.
- Resolve intended project history, then commit and push to `main`.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Update `index.html` copy: 4v4 Sacred/Chaotic mode, team-score objective, and accurate roster/roadmap claims.
2. Run browser regression checks, including healing, target validation, scoring, reset, rendering, and errors; use `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs` and `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs` if useful.
3. Review the complete diff/status and verify assets and startup scripts are preserved.
4. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, team scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked. No commit or push has occurred.
- `teamScores` increments on kills; a team reaching five ends the match, and timeout results use team scores. The player’s HUD progress reflects their team score; `index.html` still has per-player kill display, “5 BAJAS,” “todos contra todos,” and “El último en pie” copy.
- `resolveNpcAim()` rejects non-enemy targets; player skill targeting uses `canTargetWithSkill(actor, target, skill)`, with `healAlly` allowed on teammates including self. `handleCanvasTarget()` and `selectTarget()` reject invalid friend/enemy targets.
- `endMatch(_won, winnerTeam = null)` determines the winner from team scores, with a tie outcome. Latest edits, including bot healing, have not been browser-tested.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).
- Current `game.js` implements 4v4 teams with Sacred/Chaotic team scores, a five-kill team goal, team-aware match results, ally healing, and friendly-fire restrictions; update the UI and roadmap claims to match actual behavior instead of reverting logic.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Updated `game.js` to reject friendly NPC aim targets, centralize player skill-target validation, allow `healAlly` targeting of self or teammates, and track team kill scores with a five-kill goal and team-aware match results.
- Fixed bot healing to recognize both `heal` and `healAlly`; bots select the most injured living ally, apply healing and cooldowns, and emit a healing visual effect.
- Updated `index.html` visible copy to label the arena as 4v4 Sacred vs. Chaotic, clarify the five-kill team goal and personal kills, identify roster teams, and describe team victory/progress.
- `node --check game.js` passed.

### Active
- Reconcile `index.html` roadmap copy, which still says the arena is free-for-all and that 4v4 teams are pending; document what is implemented versus still unverified.
- Run browser regression checks for cleric healing, ally/enemy targeting, team scoring, reset, rendering, and errors; inspect remaining combat requirements.
- Review all changes and preserve recovered files.
- Resolve intended project history, then commit and push to `main`.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Update `index.html` roadmap claims to reflect implemented 4v4 teams, team scoring, targeting, and healing; leave unverified features explicitly pending.
2. Run browser regression checks, including healing, target validation, scoring, reset, rendering, and errors; use `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs` and `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs` if useful.
3. Review the complete diff/status and verify assets and startup scripts are preserved.
4. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, team scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.

## Important Context
- Latest Git status before the recent UI edits: branch `main`; `README.md` modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `assets/`, `capture.sh`, `favicon.svg`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css` untracked. No commit or push has occurred.
- `teamScores` increments on kills; a team reaching five ends the match, and timeout results use team scores. The player’s HUD progress reflects their team score; individual kill counters remain per player.
- `resolveNpcAim()` rejects non-enemy targets; player skill targeting uses `canTargetWithSkill(actor, target, skill)`, with `healAlly` allowed on teammates including self. `handleCanvasTarget()` and `selectTarget()` reject invalid friend/enemy targets.
- `endMatch(_won, winnerTeam = null)` determines the winner from team scores, with a tie outcome. `resetGame()` resets both team scores and combatants.
- The roster is one player and seven bots: four per team, with warrior, mage, cleric, and paladin roles. Visible mana bars for every combatant and several requested tactical/aiming behaviors remain unverified or pending.

1: # Argentum Online — Arena del Robledal
2: 
3: Prototipo web jugable inspirado en Argentum Online. Incluye una arena de combate local, movimiento por tiles, bots, ataques cuerpo a cuerpo, habilidades por clase y controles táctiles; funciona en navegador sin backend.
4: 
5: ## Ejecutar
6: 
7: Serví esta carpeta por HTTP, por ejemplo:
8: 
9: ```bash
10: python3 -m http.server 8000
11: ```
12: 
13: Después abrí <http://localhost:8000>.
14: 
15: ## Controles
16: 
17: - **Flechas o WASD:** moverse.
18: - **Clic en un personaje o Tab:** elegir objetivo.
19: - **F o Enter:** atacar al objetivo adyacente.
20: - **1–3:** elegir/cancelar habilidad; luego clic en un rival para atacar o en tu personaje para curarte.
21: - **Combatientes / Esc:** mostrar el marcador o cerrar paneles.
22: - **☰:** pausar o reanudar.
23: - **Móvil:** pad táctil para moverse y botón de ataque.
24: 
25: ## Archivos
26: 
27: - `index.html`, `styles.css`, `game.js`: aplicación web.
28: - `assets/ao/`: mapa, datos de personajes y gráficos usados por el juego.
29: - `scripts/extract_ao_assets.py`: herramienta de extracción de los recursos AO incluidos.
30: 
31: La aplicación y sus recursos fueron recuperados de [gamer-frog/PLAYGROUND](https://github.com/gamer-frog/PLAYGROUND), checkpoint `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` (rama `opencode-checkpoints/18`, 6 de noviembre de 2026). Se copiaron los archivos de la aplicación y sus recursos al repositorio `Argentum_Online_AGITE`; el clon de origen no forma parte de este repositorio. Esta recuperación no implica que los cambios se hayan publicado o integrado en `main`.

## Objective
- Complete the Reinos MVP from checkpoint 18, verify it, update its roadmap, then commit and push to `main`.
- The user asked: “Quiero irme a dormir y dejar en tus manitas todo. Tenes que implementar todo. Loopeate horas y pushea a main”.

## Requirements
- Work from checkpoint 18 only; do not mix checkpoints 19, 21, 22, 23, or issue #4 branches without confirmation.
- Distinguish implemented and verified features from pending work; prioritize a recognizable AO HUD, visible inventory and potions, legible combat, and visible independent aiming—no autoaim or invisible autoclick.
- Implement tactical Inmo/Remo/escape decisions, distinct attack and spell intervals, and 4v4 teams.
- Keep the roadmap current with requests, technologies, resources, classes, and remaining work.

## Decisions
- Intended source is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/18`, revision `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc`.
- Do not incorporate `origin/opencode-checkpoints/4` or `origin/opencode-deployments/4`; they relate to issue #4 and were not confirmed as Reinos.
- `origin` is `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Argentum_Online_AGITE`; local and remote `main` point to grafted commit `5291e3e` (“Install OpenCode issue listener”).
- Current `game.js` implements 4v4 teams with Sacred/Chaotic team scores, a five-kill team goal, team-aware match results, ally healing, and friendly-fire restrictions; update the UI and roadmap claims to match actual behavior instead of reverting logic.

## Work State
### Completed
- Recovered project/application resources and added a Reinos roadmap to `index.html`; updated provenance and run instructions in `README.md`.
- Corrected the eight-combatant roster, scoring IDs, reset behavior, target selection, classes/spells, potions, NPC placement, aiming, ranged damage, and melee damage.
- Added team identity helpers/constants and ally-healing support; friendly melee attacks are blocked.
- Updated `game.js` to reject friendly NPC aim targets, centralize player skill-target validation, allow `healAlly` targeting of self or teammates, and track team kill scores with a five-kill goal and team-aware match results.
- Fixed bot healing to recognize both `heal` and `healAlly`; bots select the most injured living ally, apply healing and cooldowns, and emit a healing visual effect.
- Updated the main interface and roster labels in `index.html` to reflect 4v4 Sacred vs. Chaotic teams, team victory/progress, five team kills, and personal kills.
- `node --check game.js` passed.

### Active
- Fix stale roadmap text in `index.html`: lines 74 and 77 still describe free-for-all and 4v4 as pending; line 83 also says the implemented composition does not exist. Update other relevant claims to accurately separate implemented from unverified behavior.
- Run browser regression checks for healing, target validation, team scoring, reset, rendering, and errors; inspect remaining combat requirements.
- Review all changes and preserve recovered files.
- Resolve intended project history, then commit and push to `main`.

### Blocked
- Intended checkpoint commit `bb607ed43d187283e4defe41f27340bc7f1170fc` is absent from this checkout (`git cat-file` returned `could not get object info`); its ancestry cannot be established.
- The checkpoint branch is absent from `git ls-remote` results; only `main` and `opencode-deployments/4` appeared.
- Project files remain uncommitted; many are untracked. Publishing the recovered project on `main` still requires resolving the intended base.

## Next Move
1. Correct roadmap status claims in `index.html`, documenting existing 4v4 teams, team scoring, ally healing, and targeting while keeping unverified behavior explicitly pending.
2. Run browser regression checks, including healing, target validation, scoring, reset, rendering, and errors; use `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs` and `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs` if useful.
3. Review complete diff/status and verify assets and startup scripts are preserved.
4. Establish the intended history, then commit and push to `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: combat, targeting, AI, healing, team scoring, match end/reset, rendering.
- `index.html`: interface, roster, result text, project roadmap.
- `styles.css`: HUD and arena presentation.
- `README.md`: project provenance and run instructions.
- `assets/ao/`: map and AO graphics/data.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-interactive.cjs`: browser test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/reinos-melee.cjs`: browser test script.
